gm.motif: compact oblate Si20 (principal radii^2 1.78/3.53/3.54 A^2), Si CN 5-7, Si-Si >= 2.436 A
gm.second_isomer: prolate Si20 (radii^2 2.33/2.34/4.14 A^2), +2.5 meV at fmax 0.05, +2.0 meV after tight relaxation (fmax 0.002); found by 8 of 20 pilot runs vs 12 for the oblate GM
gm.literature: prolate stacked-TTP structures for Si_n n~12-25 from ion mobility + DFT (Ho et al., Nature 392, 582 (1998)); compact isomers competitive near n=20

notes: Replaces cl_Si10 (TTP GM found by all 20 pilot runs, BH ERT 46) and cl_Si16 (unique GM, BH ERT 3330 but RS ERT 1404). Final budget 34000 = 3 x BH median hit 11447. Random search beats BH here (RS ERT 6.8k vs BH 13.2k). Two near-degenerate NEP89 isomers (oblate GM, prolate +2 meV) both count as hits with e_tol 0.02; same-structure spread at fmax 0.05 <= 5 meV, so e_tol stays 0.02.

bulk_reference_nep89.phase: diamond Si, a=5.396 A (NEP89 puts a beta-tin-like phase ~0.05 eV/atom lower, see bu_Si8)
bulk_reference_nep89.verdict: cluster less stable than bulk (no NEP89-hole signature)
